question: Three of the following letter - clusters are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7020d19c9bc05b9f53ef673a4286e59d49de7081ee20a737fb715dc138374b5d.png] 

1) **O** K **N** L - Difference between** Positional values of 1st and 3rd letter is 0.**

2) **J** Q **A** Z - Difference between **Positional values of 1st and 3rd letter is 9.**

3) **F** B **E** C - Difference between** Positional values of 1st and 3rd letter is 0.**

4) **H** D **G** F - Difference between** Positional values of 1st and 3rd letter is 0.**

There is only one Option which is different from others JQAZ

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 2"**
